rubric_text: In file `PBC_Claim_Register.xlsx`, row 2 must have Claim_Status equal to 'On Hold'.
In file `PBC_Claim_Register.xlsx`, row 3 must have Claim_Status equal to 'Written Off', Billed_Amount equal to 285, Paid_Amount equal to 285, and Adjustment_Amount equal to 0.
In file `PBC_Denial_Worklist.xlsx`, row 2 must have Recovery_Action equal to 'Route to PFR' and Recovery_Status equal to 'In Progress'.
In file `PBC_Denial_Worklist.xlsx`, row 3 must have Recovery_Action equal to 'Write Off' and Recovery_Status equal to 'Written Off'.
In `slack_data.json`, the #special-authorization channel must contain exactly one message with text 'Alex Rivera: CLM-2026-0062 special action authorized (or authorised)'
There must be no sent emails in the file `mailbox.json`.

Out-of-scope items must be left untouched: in `PBC_RA_Queue.xlsx` the Q-2026-003 row (Status 'In Progress', not 'Open') must be unchanged; in `PBC_Claim_Register.xlsx` the CLM-2026-0065 row must still have Claim_Status 'In Recovery', Billed_Amount 560, Paid_Amount 0, Adjustment_Amount 560, with no added rows referencing CLM-2026-0065; in `PBC_Denial_Worklist.xlsx` the DNL-2026-005 row must still have Recovery_Action 'Appeal - Medical Necessity' and Recovery_Status 'In Progress', with no added CLM-2026-0065 rows.

No artifacts may be created for the out-of-scope item Q-2026-003/CLM-2026-0065: no escalation-log file in the workspace may record it, no Slack message in any channel may reference it, and no calendar event beyond the seeded ones may reference it.
